title: pi-dynamic-workflows contract runs biome `check` before build/test — only ERRORS gate; FIXABLE WARNINGS proceed
detail: In the contract lane, pi-dynamic-workflows runs `bun run check` (biome) BEFORE build + bun test. A biome ERROR exits the stage with code 1 and build/test never execute, so contract.overallOk=false with no signal on whether the actual tests pass. BUT biome FIXABLE WARNINGS are non-blocking: run 2026-07-04T04-50-16 emitted 2 warnings (noUnusedVariables 'pi' in task-panel.test.ts:417; noUnusedImports in workflow-manager.test.ts:1) yet tsc build was clean and bun test passed 768/0 — pdw contract green. Recurring fixable warning locations observed across runs: organizeImports import-sort in workflow.test.ts; noUnusedVariables in task-panel.test.ts; noUnusedImports in workflow-manager.test.ts. When pdw fails the contract lane on biome, distinguish ERROR (gates, masks tests) from WARNING (proceeds) — re-run `bun run build && bun test` locally to separate lint drift from a real test regression before diagnosing.

title: build lane (build:all + verify e2e) is stable and green across runs
detail: The build lane consistently produces a working pi-agent bundle + standalone binary and passes the verify e2e gate. Observed 2026-07-04: buildAllOk=true, verifyOk=true. Artifacts: dist/pi-agent/pi-agent.js (6.8 MB) + pi-agent.js.map; symlink node_modules → pi deps store; standalone binary dist/pi-agent/pi-agent (70.2 MB); copied assets (theme/, export-html/, assets/). Modes: bundle+minify + standalone binary compile. verify (e2e-extensions.test.ts): 1 pass, 25 skip, 0 fail, 5 expect() calls (3.20s), no extension-load errors. Treat build-lane failures as environmental/sandbox, not code regressions, unless reproducible.

title: Bun package contract test-count baselines (2026-07-04)
detail: Contract lane per-package pass counts for regression detection — a sudden drop signals a real regression or a skipped-file leak. pi-agent: 670 pass / 39 skip / 0 fail (1449 expect(), 36 files, 7.13s). pi-agent-cli: 179 pass / 0 fail (292 expect(), 9 files, 383ms). pi-vlm: 110 pass / 0 fail (282 expect(), 11 files, 299ms). pi-obsidian: 337 pass / 0 fail (746 expect(), 42 files, 600ms) — includes frozen baseline-contract + search benchmark (18 notes: cold=1.0ms warm=0.6ms). pi-dynamic-workflows: 768 pass / 0 fail (34 files, 4.53s) — biome warnings non-blocking, tsc build clean, bun test green (confirmed 2026-07-04T04-50-16; was UNKNOWN on first sighting because a biome ERROR had masked tests).

title: fix:true refuses on dirty tree — workflow's OWN emitted artifacts count as dirty
detail: The fix lane (effort:medium + fix:true) correctly refuses to apply when the git tree is dirty. Gotcha: the workflow's OWN emitted/persisted artifacts are themselves counted as dirty, so a prior or concurrent self-improve run leaves the tree blocked even when no real source changed. Run 2026-07-04T04-50-16 fix was skipped with porcelain listing exactly: .claude/workflows/_shared-patterns.md, .claude/workflows/pi-agent-ext-flux2-self-improve.knowledge.jsonl, .claude/workflows/pi-infra-self-improve.js. To unblock fix:true: commit/stash these workflow artifacts (or run fix in isolation on a clean checkout) before invoking. Do NOT treat this skip as a code regression — it is by-design collision avoidance.
